description: YouTube comments API for AI agents: send the URL of a video and get its comments as JSON: text, time, likes and reply count. Up to 100 comments per call. The commenters' names and handles are not returned. Pay per call in stablecoins; comments you paid for but did not get are refunded.

limit.description: number of comments wanted, 1 to 100 (default 20). A larger value is lowered to 100 and 0 or a negative one means the default; the quote follows the value used.

sort.description: top comments first (default) or the newest first

url.description: URL of a YouTube video, e.g. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ

name: youtube-comments
title: Comments under a YouTube video
